answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in saffron, expire in tide, and gale lists each expiry. Anyone running 154 aliases therefore needs 184 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1153 identities would post 4448 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
